name: delete_game
description: Permanently deletes a game and all its associated data (characters, NPCs, memories). This is irreversible. Requires confirm_name to exactly match the game's name as a safeguard against accidental deletion.

slug.description: The slug of the game to delete.

confirm_name.description: Must exactly match the game's name (case-sensitive). Use list_games or the game's known name. Deletion is rejected if this does not match.
